title: Valuables and the loot you carry out
summary: The point of a run is the loot: R.E.P.O. scatters valuables that are worth money, and they are heavy, breakable objects you have to physically carry to the extraction point.
body: Valuables are individual objects with their own behaviour, from small items such as an egg to large awkward things such as a traffic light or a blender.
Because they are physics objects, how you carry them matters: dropping one can damage it and reduce what it is worth.
Each level decides which valuables it places, which is why the same run can look very different from the last one.
What this entry does not tell you: how much any specific valuable is worth, or its exact spawn chance. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Valuables are separate objects, each with its own behaviour.
At least one valuable is packaged in a box you can pick up.
Each level decides which valuables it contains.
Some valuables are small and odd, such as an egg.
